definitions.full: H6007. Amasyah עֲמַסְיָה proper name, masculine name in Judah 2Chr 17:16 , ᵐ5 Μασαιας , ᵐ5 L Αμασιας (compare Phoenician בעלעמס אשמנעמס, CIS i. 139, 169, 719 , see also Gray Prop. N. 296 f. ).
